headline: Jobber is making it cheaper to leave us, and ServiceTitan is making it easier to start with them. Both are aiming at our 5 to 20 tech shops.

audiences.label: Leadership
audiences.summary: Two decisions this week, and one roadmap question.

items.title: Decide how we answer Jobber on price
items.detail: Jobber's entry plan now includes online booking, and their comparison page claims a lower total cost. Reps can hold the line with cost math, but the entry-plan gap is gone.
items.action: Decision: hold pricing and lead with year-one cost at the next team size, or add a booking-led offer to our entry plan for Q1.

items.title: Protect the 5 to 20 tech segment from ServiceTitan
items.detail: Hiring, blog content, earnings commentary, and now a 30-day onboarding package all point the same way. This is our core segment.
items.action: Ask: fund a 'live in two weeks' switch guarantee, and give CS a renewal play for accounts in that range.

items.title: Get a date for AI call answering
items.detail: Jobber's AI receptionist is live, and prospects raise missed calls on first calls. So far reps only have a holding answer.
items.action: Ask Product for a date reps can share, or a firm 'not this year' so we position around it.

audiences.label: SDRs
audiences.summary: Three reasons to reach out this week, with the opener for each.

items.title: Jobber customers on the entry plan
items.detail: Jobber just changed its plans. Owners are already looking at what they pay and what they get.
items.action: Opener: "Jobber just changed its plans. Worth a 15-minute look at what you'd pay with two more techs, on both?"

items.title: 5 to 20 tech HVAC and plumbing shops looking at ServiceTitan
items.detail: ServiceTitan is pitching faster setup to shops this size. Lead with setup time and contract length.
items.action: Opener: "How long did they quote for setup, and who runs your office while it happens? Northline went live with us in 11 days."

items.title: Lawn care and cleaning companies
items.detail: Jobber mentions are up three weeks running in these trades. Missed calls are the pain to lead with.
items.action: Opener: "What does a missed call cost you in spring? Greenleaf books evenings and weekends online now."

audiences.label: Team
audiences.summary: What changes in your work this week.

items.title: AEs: use the updated Jobber card
items.detail: New response to 'Jobber is cheaper all-in' and a landmine about the AI receptionist.
items.action: Use the cost worksheet in every Jobber deal past discovery.

items.title: CS: flag 5 to 20 tech accounts renewing in Q1
items.detail: ServiceTitan is aiming at exactly these accounts, and Jobber published a guide to switching away from us.
items.action: Add a competitor check to Q1 renewal calls and log any mention.

items.title: Marketing: answer Jobber's comparison page
items.detail: Their page changed Monday and prospects will quote it.
items.action: Update our Jobber comparison page by Friday with a same-features, next-team-size cost table.

items.title: Enablement: 15 minutes on missed calls
items.detail: After-hours calls came up in most Jobber deals this month.
items.action: Add the missed-call talk track to Friday's sales huddle.
